principle: Adopt mechanisms only when they improve a live goal-fidelity failure mode; source prestige, popularity, novelty, and obscurity are evidence attributes, not automatic authority.

sources.title: RECAP: REwriting Conversations for Intent Understanding in Agentic Planning
sources.adopted_mechanism: Evaluate intent representations by downstream planning utility under ambiguity, drift, vagueness, and mixed goals rather than paraphrase similarity.
sources.limitations: Small public repository adoption; use as a targeted research mechanism, not a scale signal.

sources.title: AI evals and agentic workflow evaluation
sources.adopted_mechanism: Judge end-to-end task success first, then identify the first upstream failure and use step diagnostics only after the user-goal verdict.
sources.limitations: Methodology guidance rather than a formal benchmark.

sources.title: Error analysis for LLM evals
sources.adopted_mechanism: Build eval taxonomies from representative real traces through open/axial coding before adding more rules or judges.
sources.limitations: Human review remains important; taxonomy quality depends on representative traces.

sources.title: DSPy GEPA reflective optimization
sources.adopted_mechanism: Optimize prompts/program artifacts from execution traces and rich textual feedback; require holdout improvement and protect hard slices against aggregate-score masking.
sources.limitations: Optimizer quality is bounded by metric, feedback, and evaluation-set quality.

sources.title: Context Engineering for AI Agents: Lessons from Building Manus
sources.adopted_mechanism: Use recurring compact goal/todo recitation near the recent context boundary to fight long-trajectory goal drift while keeping durable state outside prompt prose.
sources.limitations: Production design report rather than independent controlled benchmark.

sources.title: Magentic-One task/progress ledger architecture
sources.adopted_mechanism: Separate durable task facts/plan from short-horizon progress, detect loops/stalls, and replan only when progress evidence warrants it.
sources.limitations: Architecture pattern; not evidence that every task benefits from multi-agent orchestration.

sources.title: OpenCTI
sources.adopted_mechanism: Model evidence as a provenance/confidence graph with source linkage, first/last-seen timing, relationships, and explicit confidence instead of flattening threat-intelligence claims into text.
sources.limitations: Cyber-threat-intelligence domain pattern; imported only for opaque-source provenance mechanics.

sources.title: MISP
sources.adopted_mechanism: Keep atomic indicators/claims linked to structured objects, reports, provenance, and cross-references so anonymous or underground-source leads remain distinguishable from corroborated evidence.
sources.limitations: Cybersecurity evidence-sharing pattern; does not make dark-web or anonymous claims inherently reliable.
